description: Checks a Solana wallet and summarizes whether anything needs attention: current holdings, held yield tokens compared with the best risk-adjusted executable yield, and for each held xStock its live premium or discount to the underlying stock with a timing signal. Returns short plain-language notes (for example idle USDC earning nothing, or a held xStock trading at a premium). Read-only.
name: portfolio_health

bestExecutableYield.description: Best risk-adjusted yield available for idle USDC

xstockTiming.description: Timing signal per held tokenized stock
